note: Lake Oroville SRA campground on a knoll above Bidwell Canyon Marina and its launch ramp, in two paved loops: Gold Flat (sites 1-39) and Big Pine (sites 40-75). All sites have full hookups. Pads are 40 ft, except nine Big Pine sites at 27 ft. Tokens buy the showers. The lake drops far below the campground by late summer. --Claude
summary: Bidwell Canyon: rate now $60 (was $45), 50 A full hookups (was 30), loops Gold Flat 1-39 (Apr-Oct) and Big Pine 40-75 (all year; the stored note had the names swapped); no closure notice; lakeview kept, with a lead on the south loop's east edge; pin fine; campground phone (530) 538-2218.
flags: FEES: $45 -> $60. Every ReserveCalifornia quote from Jan to May 2027 is $60, including a Saturday; the stored $45 was read 2026-10-12 for June 2027.
HOOKUPS: electric 30 -> 50 ('Electricity Hookup': '50 amps' on every unit checked).
LOOP NAMES: the stored note had them swapped. RDR facility 797 'Bidwell Canyon (sites 1-39)' = 'Gold Flat Campground' (unit names GF01-GF39); 544 'sites 40-75' = 'Big Pine Campground' (BP40-BP75).
SITE COUNT: 75 by the facility names, but only 62 web units are listed (31 + 31). The rest are presumably host, ADA-by-phone or retired sites.

WATERFRONT LEAD (lakeview kept; no change proposed): the south loop (Gold Flat)'s east edge at ~39.5326,-121.4567 sits ~279 m, 3-4 m above and only ~20-25 m from the 900-ft full-pool contour (~275 m NAVD88), over wooded ground. Its neighbour to the east is the launch-ramp parking. Site numbers on that edge are not known (RDR map coordinates are image pixels), the lake reaches full pool only in wet springs, and the edge is under trees, so it stays a view. The north loop (Big Pine) is ~60-70 m back and ~7 m up. Stored evidence holds.
